# Breadcrumbs

**Status:** available. **Category:** navigation. **In the demo:** `/gallery/breadcrumbs`.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

Use breadcrumbs to help users navigate.

[Breadcrumbs documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/breadcrumbs/)

## Class names
- component: `breadcrumbs`

## Syntax
```html
<div class="breadcrumbs">
  <ul><li><a>Link</a></li></ul>
</div>
```

## Rules
- The breadcrumbs component has one main class name.
- You can put icons in the links.
- If you set `max-width` or the list becomes wider than its container, the breadcrumbs list scrolls.
